## About
Superior Exotics Team, also known as S.E.T. Motor Sports, works on European and exotic cars in Davie, from Porsche and Lamborghini to Ferrari. Yass Salman started the company out of a deep passion for luxury vehicles, and he put together a team who share his attention to detail.
The crew includes European master techs Carlos, Abel, Albert and Leo, Ozzy in the body and paint shop, and Dahoud, our insurance claim specialist. Christian and Noah keep operations and service running day to day.
Two customers wrote that Yass and the staff treat you like family, and one said Yass took the time to explain everything. We're grateful for a 4.9 rating from 394 Google reviews.

## Services
- Repair: Mechanical repair for European and exotic cars, so your car runs right and looks right.
- Collision repair: Collision work for European cars, done in house by our own team to bring your car back to its pre-accident condition.
- Detailing: Full interior and exterior detailing, polishing and ceramic coating.
- Customization: Performance upgrades, custom paint and bodywork, and interior upgrades for exotic cars. Call us to talk through what you have in mind.
- Rental cars: If your car needs to stay with us a while, we can set you up with a rental.

## FAQ
Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: It depends on what your car needs. We give free estimates for all services, so you know the cost before any work starts.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company on a collision repair?
A: Yes. We work with a variety of insurance companies and can help guide you through the claims process.

Q: Can I wait while my car is serviced?
A: Yes. Our waiting area has complimentary beverages, snacks, massage chairs and Wi-Fi. Some jobs take longer, and for those we can arrange a rental car.

Q: How often should I bring my car in for maintenance?
A: We recommend every 6 months to a year, depending on your car. Our technicians can give you recommendations based on how you drive and the condition of your car.

Q: What types of payment do you accept?
A: We accept all major credit cards, cash, checks, and car insurance when applicable.
